sources.title: Crop evapotranspiration — Chapter 8: ETc under soil water stress conditions
lockedClaims: The root-zone soil water balance is a container model expressed as water depth.
Equation 85 keeps precipitation, runoff, irrigation, capillary rise, evapotranspiration and deep percolation as distinct terms, each in millimetres.

sources.title: Storm Water Management Model User's Manual Version 5.2
lockedClaims: Continuity error compares initial storage plus total inflow with final storage plus total outflow.
LID summaries report inflow, evaporation, infiltration, surface/underdrain outflow and initial/final storage separately.
Time-step selection can contribute to continuity errors.

sources.title: Storm Water Management Model Reference Manual Volume I — Hydrology
lockedClaims: Runoff quantity is tracked within subcatchments while flow and depth are routed through links over multiple time steps.

independenceNote: FAO and US EPA are distinct institutional documentation roots. The Node.js fixture is an executable derivation of their accounting constraints, not a third empirical hydrology observation root.
